_readme: Copy to config.json and edit. Any key you omit uses the built-in default, so core updates never break your config. Secrets do NOT go here — the setup wizard saves secrets.local.json; manual setups may use .env / run_barrel.bat. The dashboard setup wizard at /setup can create this config. ollama_host is the Ollama server URL; OLLAMA_HOST in the environment overrides it. Set vision_model (e.g. gemma3:4b) to enable photo understanding via Telegram; empty disables it. Telegram is optional: with no TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN/TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_IDS the Barrel runs local-only through the dashboard. dashboard_token is required only if you bind dashboard_host beyond 127.0.0.1.
